docket_entries.description: RENEWAL OF JUDGMENT ON CASE 733125 FILED BY PLAINTIFF CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO INVESTIGATION DIV AS TO DEFENDANT MC CABE, RICHARD IND DBA LIGHTNING COMPUTER
